summary: Soundstage is an American live concert television series produced by WTTW Chicago and HD Ready. The original run lasted 13 seasons from 1974 to 1985, and a new run of seasons began in 2003, with the latest, Season 11, starting in April 2018. Episodes are presented in high definition with surround sound, some performances have been released on DVD, and taping takes place at the WTTW studio in Chicago and at large venues across the United States.
